subject: Chemistry
title: Chemical Thermodynamics
summary: System = jo hum study kar rahe hain, surroundings = baaki sab. Open system energy aur matter dono exchange karta hai, closed sirf energy, isolated kuch nahi. State functions (U, H, S, G, p, V, T) sirf shuruaat aur ant par depend karte hain; heat aur work path functions hain.

First law energy conservation hai: ΔU = q + w (chemistry sign convention: system PAR kiya gaya kaam aur system KO di gayi heat positive). Constant volume par heat = ΔU, constant pressure par heat = ΔH.

Enthalpy additive hai: Hess's law se kisi bhi reaction ka ΔH doosri reactions jod-ghata ke nikal sakte hain. Formation, combustion, bond, atomisation, phase change — sab enthalpies isi logic se judti hain.
Second law: koi bhi spontaneous process universe ki entropy badhata hai (ΔS_total > 0). System ke liye ek hi number kaafi hai — Gibbs energy: constant T, p par ΔG < 0 matlab spontaneous.
ΔG° = −RT ln K: standard Gibbs energy aur equilibrium constant ek doosre se jude hain. ΔG° negative ⇒ K > 1 (products favoured).

formulas.name: First law
formulas.mistake: Chemistry: system par kaam (+w), system dwara kaam (−w). Physics books mein ulta convention hota hai.

formulas.name: Work of expansion (irreversible)
formulas.when: Constant bahari pressure ke against phailna.

formulas.name: Enthalpy
formulas.formula: H = U + pV;   ΔH = ΔU + Δn_g RT
formulas.mistake: Δn_g = gaseous products ke moles − gaseous reactants ke moles; solids/liquids mat gino.

formulas.name: Heat at constant V and p
formulas.when: Bomb calorimeter (V const) ΔU deta hai; coffee-cup (p const) ΔH.

formulas.name: Heat capacity
formulas.formula: q = C ΔT = n C_m ΔT;   C_p − C_V = R (ideal gas, molar);   monoatomic: C_V = 3R/2, C_p = 5R/2
formulas.mistake: Specific heat (per gram) aur molar heat capacity (per mole) alag hain.

formulas.name: Adiabatic process
formulas.formula: q = 0 ⇒ ΔU = w;   reversible ideal gas: TV^{γ−1} = constant,  pV^γ = constant
formulas.mistake: Reversible adiabatic expansion mein gas thandi hoti hai (kaam apni internal energy se karti hai). Ideal gas ka free expansion: ΔT = 0.

formulas.name: Hess's law
formulas.formula: ΔH (overall) = ΔH₁ + ΔH₂ + …   (reaction ulti → ΔH ka sign ulta;  ×n → ΔH × n)
formulas.when: Seedhe naap na sakne wali reaction ka ΔH.

formulas.name: From enthalpies of formation
formulas.formula: Δ_rH° = Σ Δ_fH°(products) − Σ Δ_fH°(reactants);   element ki standard state ka Δ_fH° = 0
formulas.mistake: Coefficient se multiply karna mat bhoolo.

formulas.name: From bond enthalpies
formulas.formula: Δ_rH = Σ BE(reactants, bonds toote) − Σ BE(products, bonds bane)
formulas.mistake: Yahan reactants − products (formation wale ka ulta).

formulas.name: Types of enthalpy
formulas.formula: Combustion (1 mol + O₂), atomisation (1 mol → gaseous atoms), sublimation = fusion + vaporisation, ionisation, hydration (gaseous ion → aq), solution = lattice + hydration, neutralisation (strong acid + strong base ≈ −57.1 kJ/mol)
formulas.mistake: Weak acid/base ke saath neutralisation kam exothermic (ionisation mein energy lagti hai).

formulas.name: Entropy change
formulas.formula: ΔS = q_rev / T;   phase change: ΔS = ΔH_trans / T_trans;   ideal gas isothermal: ΔS = 2.303 nR log(V₂/V₁)

formulas.name: Gibbs energy
formulas.formula: G = H − TS;   ΔG = ΔH − TΔS;   ΔG = −T ΔS_total

formulas.name: Sign table (ΔH, ΔS)
formulas.formula: (−, +): hamesha spontaneous.  (+, −): kabhi nahi.  (−, −): low T par.  (+, +): high T par.   Switch temperature T = ΔH/ΔS
formulas.mistake: ΔS ko J se kJ mein badal kar hi ΔH ke saath jodo.

formulas.name: ΔG° and equilibrium constant
formulas.formula: ΔG° = −RT ln K = −2.303 RT log K;   ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q
formulas.mistake: R = 8.314 J/(K·mol) — ΔG° ko J mein rakho.

examples.title: Bahari pressure ke against kaam
examples.problem: Gas 1 atm constant bahari pressure ke against 2 L se 10 L phailti hai. Work?
examples.solution: w = −p_ext ΔV = −1 × 8 = −8 L·atm = −8 × 101.3 J ≈ −810 J. Negative: system ne kaam kiya.

examples.title: Reversible isothermal expansion
examples.problem: 1 mol ideal gas 300 K par reversibly 10 L se 20 L. w, q, ΔU?

examples.title: ΔH se ΔU
examples.problem: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g), ΔH = −92.4 kJ at 298 K. ΔU?

examples.title: Hess's law: CO ka formation
examples.problem: C + O₂ → CO₂, ΔH = −393.5 kJ;  CO + ½O₂ → CO₂, ΔH = −283.0 kJ. C + ½O₂ → CO ka ΔH?

examples.title: Formation enthalpies se combustion
examples.problem: Δ_fH°: CH₄ −74.8, CO₂ −393.5, H₂O(l) −285.8 kJ/mol. CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O(l) ka Δ_cH°?

examples.title: Bond enthalpy se ΔH
examples.problem: H–H 436, Cl–Cl 242, H–Cl 431 kJ/mol. H₂ + Cl₂ → 2HCl ka ΔH?

examples.title: Kis temperature par spontaneous?
examples.problem: CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂: ΔH = +179 kJ/mol, ΔS = +160 J/(K·mol). Kab spontaneous?
examples.solution: (+, +) ⇒ high T par. T = ΔH/ΔS = 179000/160 ≈ 1119 K se upar.

topics.title: System, surroundings aur boundary
topics.explain: Open (khula ubalta kettle): matter + energy exchange. Closed (band bartan): sirf energy. Isolated (ideal thermos): kuch nahi. Universe = system + surroundings.

topics.title: Extensive vs intensive properties
topics.explain: Extensive amount par depend karti hain: mass, volume, U, H, S, G, heat capacity. Intensive nahi: T, p, density, molar quantities, specific heat. Do extensive ka ratio intensive hota hai (density = m/V).

topics.title: State functions vs path functions
topics.explain: State function: sirf initial aur final state se (U, H, S, G, p, V, T) — cycle mein change zero. Path function: raaste par depend (q, w). Lekin q + w = ΔU state function hai.

topics.title: Processes
topics.explain: Isothermal (T const), isobaric (p const), isochoric (V const), adiabatic (q = 0), cyclic (wapas shuruaat par: ΔU = 0). Reversible: har kadam par equilibrium, infinitely slow; irreversible: asli, tez processes.

topics.title: Internal energy aur enthalpy ka farak
topics.explain: U = molecules ki saari energy. H = U + pV, constant pressure par di gayi heat. Solids/liquids ke liye ΔH ≈ ΔU; gases mein Δn_g RT ka farak.

topics.title: Calorimetry
topics.explain: Bomb calorimeter (sealed, constant V) ΔU naapta hai — combustion ke liye. Coffee-cup calorimeter (khula, constant p) ΔH naapta hai.

topics.title: Standard state aur formation
topics.explain: Standard state: 1 bar, diya hua T (aksar 298 K), sabse stable form (C graphite, O₂ gas, Br₂ liquid). Element ki standard state ka Δ_fH° = 0. Diamond, O₃ ka Δ_fH° zero nahi.

topics.title: Lattice aur hydration enthalpy
topics.explain: Ionic solid ka ghulna = lattice todna (+, endothermic) + ions ka hydration (−, exothermic). Δ_solH = lattice + hydration. Hydration zyada ho to ghulna exothermic.

topics.title: Spontaneity ka matlab
topics.explain: Spontaneous = bina bahari madad ke apne aap ho sakta hai (tezi se ho, zaroori nahi — jaise diamond → graphite). Sirf ΔH se faisla nahi hota (barf ka pighalna endothermic hai phir bhi 0°C se upar spontaneous); entropy bhi dekhni padti hai.

topics.title: Entropy ka feel
topics.explain: Gas > liquid > solid. Temperature badhe, moles of gas badhein, ghulna, phailna — sab entropy badhate hain. Third law: perfect crystal ki 0 K par entropy zero.

topics.title: ΔG, K aur Q
topics.explain: ΔG° < 0 ⇒ K > 1; ΔG° > 0 ⇒ K < 1. Reaction kisi bhi pal ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q se aage/peeche jaati hai; equilibrium par ΔG = 0 aur Q = K.

ratta: ΔU = q + w (chemistry convention).  q_V = ΔU,  q_p = ΔH.
ΔH = ΔU + Δn_g RT (sirf gases gino).
Δ_rH = ΣΔ_fH(P) − ΣΔ_fH(R);  bond enthalpy se: ΣBE(R) − ΣBE(P).
Strong acid + strong base neutralisation ≈ −57.1 kJ/mol.
Extensive: m, V, U, H, S, G.  Intensive: T, p, ρ, molar values.
